snippet.title: Box Knight - Launching on Steam August 25th 2026!
snippet.description:
Box Knight a Beat'Em Up, Roguelike - Castle Crashers meets South Park and Hades in The Office. 

Your once happy office has been corrupted by the monsters of workplace misery - Become the Box Knight, grab your cardboard sword and battle your way up the tower on your quest to beat up the CEO and save your coworkers from corporate purgatory.

You can play Solo, Team up in Couch Co-Op and see how long you can survive in Horde mode.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1678650/Box_Knight/

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/

X: https://x.com/wematstudios
